NBC News over the past 15 years,
Richard Engel has covered wars and
conflicts around the world. The Peabody and
Emmy Awards winner has faced dangerous and
tense conditions to bring viewers reporting from
Ukraine, Syria, Iran, and Afghanistan. Multiple
journalism organizations have honored Engel
for his courageous reporting in war zones. But in
August 2022, he faced a different life challenge
that proved even more difficult: He and his wife
lost their 6-year-old son Henry, who was born
with a rare genetic disorder called Rett syndrome.
